import sys

def pascal_case(s):
    if not s: return ""

    return "".join(p.capitalize() for p in parts if p)

def snake_case(s):
    if not s: return ""
    s = s.replace("[%s]", "").replace("%s", "")
    s = re.sub(r'(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)', r'\1_\2', s)
